name: analytics

roc.note: production = calibrated probabilities (pcal__); every other entry uses that model's uncalibrated p__ scores, as metrics.json per_model. threshold = the score at which a case starts being flagged.

reliability.note: top_label: confidence of the top class vs its accuracy (as calibration.json); aggressive: P(aggressive class) vs the observed aggressive fraction. Equal-mass bins are biased at small n.

conformal.note: Counts on the clean test split. An empty set means no class reached the conformal threshold; core.tiers sends it to tier 3 (low confidence). Coverage CIs are in conformal.json.
conformal.selection_note: aps_marginal_nonempty drives the tiers; lac_marginal was pre-registered. The switch was made after viewing test results, so the tier set's test coverage is optimistic.

triage.note: Static base tiers (no aging) of the clean test cases, as eval.queue_sim's pool; tier 1 = cases assigned to the simulated surgical lane.

queue.note: Quantiles over simulated days (simulation uncertainty only, not test-set sampling). Same arrival stream as eval.queue_sim (common random numbers); see queue_sim.json for the stated assumptions.

sources.population: clean test split (cases.csv split == test); simulated degraded / composite variants excluded as in eval/metrics.py

notes: Aggregates for plotting; headline estimates and their cluster-bootstrap CIs live in metrics.json, calibration.json and conformal.json.
Small test set (n = 132, 24 patient / pseudo-patient groups).
